title: Get a plain-English notice summary from pasted text
description: A visitor can paste a notice into the analyzer and receive a summary with key dates, options, and a draft letter.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyze
Paste a valid notice into the notice input
Explain the notice
Verify a plain-English summary is displayed
Verify key dates and options are displayed

title: Manage a waiver case after filing
description: A signed-in user can open an existing case, unlock it, mark it filed, log an SSA call, add a decision note, and access the withholding-pause letter.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the test code sign-in option
Fill the test code field with a valid test code
Submit the test code sign-in form
Navigate to /cases
Open a case from the list
Unlock the case
Mark the case as filed
Log an SSA call
Add a decision note
Download the withholding-pause letter
Verify the case timeline updates are displayed
Verify the withholding-pause letter is available

title: Unlock a case and complete the filed workflow
description: A signed-in user can unlock a waiver case, record it as filed, add follow-up notes, and download the withholding-pause letter.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the test code field with a valid test code
Submit the sign-in form
Open a case from the case list
Unlock the case
Fill in the filing date field with a valid date
Select a filing method
Mark the case as filed
Log an SSA call note
Add a decision note
Download the withholding-pause letter
Verify the case timeline shows the filed status and follow-up entries
Verify the withholding-pause letter is available for download
